title: The Internal wall of the tower
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：internal　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 internal 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 the father wrote of ① an internal wall of the tower in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② so internal that nobody in the house would go near it. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the internal ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the internal wall of the tower that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1955 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too internal to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the internal ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an internal trade of the country, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as internal as the trade of the country they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was internal or not, and he said so.

By 1968 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something internal, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite internal; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the internal ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1971, with great care, she wrote of another internal wall of the tower in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ no less internal than anybody had expected. ⑩ The internal trade of the country that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1973, was the one she could never quite name; the internal ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 内部（前置定语 an internal wall of the tower：1961 年父亲在家书里记下的那件内部的内壁）
B. adj. 内部／国内（两处加强说法：so internal that … 与 no less internal than …）
C. adj. 内部／国内（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 内部（表语 too internal to do：母亲觉得它太内部，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 国内（前置定语 an internal trade of the country：叔叔把整件事称作一桩国内的贸易）
F. adj. 国内（同级比较 as internal as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩国内的贸易相比）
G. adj. 国内（后置定语 something internal：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 国内（受程度副词修饰 quite internal：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: an internal wall of the tower
the internal wall of the tower that
an internal trade of the country
The internal trade of the country that

answers.why: internal 意为“内部”，1961 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件内部的内壁”，此处作前置定语 an internal wall of the tower。
internal 意为“内部”，此处用 so internal that 结构，说它内部到老屋里没人敢靠近。
internal 意为“内部”，家书上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的内部塔的内壁，等于最高级的说法。
internal 意为“内部”，母亲认为这件东西“太内部了，谁也用不上”，too internal to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
internal 意为“国内”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩国内的贸易”，此处作前置定语 an internal trade of the country。
internal 意为“国内”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩国内的贸易一样国内”，同级比较用 as internal as。
internal 意为“国内”，家书上那半行字要的是“国内的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something internal。
internal 意为“国内”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当国内”，quite 修饰原级 internal。
internal 意为“国内”，no less internal than 表示“其国内不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之国内不亚于任何人的预料。
internal 意为“国内”，母亲 1973 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的国内贸易”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1961 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件内部的内壁。（an internal wall of the tower）
它内部到老屋里没有一个人敢靠近。（so internal that …）
母亲觉得它太内部，谁也用不上。（too internal to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩国内的贸易。（an internal trade of the country）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩国内的贸易一样国内。（as internal as …）
到了 1968 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件国内的东西。（something internal）
answers: In 1961 the father wrote of an internal wall of the tower in the letter.
It was so internal that nobody in the house would go near it.
My mother thought it too internal to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an internal trade of the country.
He said nobody would call it as internal as the trade of the country they had once had.
By 1968 the letter asked for nothing but something internal.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 internal 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1961 the father wrote of an internal wall of the tower in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the internal wall of the tower that anybody there had ever seen, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too internal to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an internal trade of the country, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite internal, and everybody laughed.
The internal ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
